title: Hinomori Shizuku — Careful Stitching〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That should be all the weeds around here.

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line:
Check it out!
I pulled out all these weeds!

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler B
rows.Line: I pulled out a bunch too!

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler C
rows.Line: I want you to praise me too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll go one at a time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Seeing all these children smile is so wonderful. I'm so glad I agreed to help out with this event.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Let's head over to the shrine, Hinomori. We need to start preparing for the test of courage.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have to go now, but please keep doing your best to pull as many weeds as you can for me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I want them all to keep having fun, so I'll need to do my best as a scarer.)

rows.Speaker: Local B
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
You're Shizuku, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm playing a yuki-onna right now.
Look, I can make it snow... Huh? Nothing's coming out...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I pressed the wrong button...
Let me try that again... I'm going to make it snow now, so please take this opportunity to cool off if you like.

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler B
rows.Line:
That breeze... Huh?!
Oh, it's you, nice lady!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Are you all enjoying yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler C
rows.Line: Yeah! This test of courage isn't scary at all!

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line: Look! We got these balloon dogs from that other nice lady we met!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so nice.
But please be careful since it's very dark up ahead.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Phew... Those children were the last group.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Asahina said she'd come and get me, but I'm not where I originally was. I should head back to my spot.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's strange...
There should be that tree with the piece of cloth we hung up as a trail marker...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, this path looks somewhat familiar...
If I keep going, I should be able to—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(A little girl...?
I don't remember her volunteering today...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you going to show me the way?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate it.
Hehe. Even though you're a yuki-onna, your hand's warmer than mine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But your hand feels nice and cool.

*Nod*
We usually don't go out much, but I came to see what was going on since there were so many people here today.
Also, you looked a little lost.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This is a little embarrassing...
But I'm glad you decided to help me. Thank you for being so kind.
It seems my friend brought her here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori, there you are. Thank goodness I was able to find you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I got a little lost, but this little girl kindly showed me where to—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I hope I get to see her again someday. I really need to thank her again for what she did...)
